translated_title: Mexico Sends First Humanitarian Aid to Colombia After Earthquake
original_title: México envía primera ayuda humanitaria a Colombia tras sismo
author: Fernanda Monroy
meta_description: Two Air Force planes carried the first 19.5 tons of food to Pereira; Mexico has pledged 58.5 tons over three flights, with 255 troops and rescue-dog teams on standby.
